issue: The vertical resource ladder places execution units (tensor cores/ALU) between registers and shared memory and runs the 'capacity grows' gradient through them, conflating compute throughput with memory capacity.
evidence: The box 'tensor cores / ALU — arithmetic units' sits under the red 'capacity grows speed drops distance grows' arrow; the caption calls the ladder a resource hierarchy but does not say tensor cores are compute-only.
acceptance_test: Revise the figure to separate execution resources from storage tiers, or explicitly mark tensor cores as compute-only and outside the capacity gradient; verify a reader does not infer tensor cores have memory capacity.

issue: The text 'GPU↔GPU and host link' in the green interconnect box is set tight against the left border and may clip or touch the border at print size.
evidence: The first glyph begins at the box edge; the box is only as wide as the text.
acceptance_test: Add horizontal padding or widen the box; render at print size and confirm no glyph touches or crosses the border.

issue: The caption says 'only ~1–2 at 128K', but the figure's own KV 335 GB and the fixed 436 GB KV budget imply 436/335 ≈ 1.30, i.e., one full request, not two.
evidence: Figure labels 'KV 335 GB' at 128K; caption states fixed ~436 GB KV budget; 436/335 = 1.30.
acceptance_test: Change the caption to '~1.3, floor 1' or 'only 1' and ensure the prose does not imply two concurrent 128K requests fit.

acceptance_test: Reorder the legend to match stack order or add a 'bottom to top' note; verify a reader can map legend entries to segments without scanning.
